title: chats table missing index on changed_at_counter — Chat/changes does full table scan
description: The Chat/changes query filters WHERE changed_at_counter > ?1 ORDER BY changed_at_counter ASC but there is no index on chats(changed_at_counter). On large chat histories this becomes a full table scan. Fix: add CREATE INDEX idx_chats_changed_at_counter ON chats(changed_at_counter) in a new migration.
